author: Samsung
description:
Growing up in a small township in South Africa, Lefa Makgato didn’t know what to dream about because technology felt so far out of reach. But a single encounter with Samsung’s Solar-powered Internet school changed everything. 

Today, she’s leading Samsung’s CSR initiatives in Africa, including Solve for Tomorrow, which empowers young students in Africa to lead digital innovations. This film follows Lefa’s powerful journey from being a recipient of an opportunity, to creating the same opportunity for others.

Learn more: samsung.com
